newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean inspection destinations - USDA.

text.p: The 38.924 million bushels of U.S. soybeans inspected for export in the week ended Nov 14 were for the following destinations (1,000 bushels):

Toledo to Portugal 688. Mississippi River to Chile 217, China 6,811, Germany 6,327, Indonesia 2,261, Israel 890, Italy 1,871, Japan 1,232, S.Korea 3,263, Holland 266, Spain 1,661, Trinidad 397, UK 2,085.
East Gulf to Japan 2,038. Puget Sound to Taiwan 2,083. North Texas to Brazil 1,240, Mexico 639, Turkey 617. Columbia River to Japan 310. Interior to Mexico 1,163.
